To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
AWWs are effective in delivering health information to the urban communities and in increasing drug coverage and consumption in MDA programs for LF elimination.

the coverage and consumption of MDA program for elimination of lymphatic filariiasis was relatively high in urban areas of Pondcherry, South India when the AWWs of ICDS were involved as the communicators and drug distributers, and the main reason for non consumption was fear of side reactions.

1) AWWs are a potential cadre to be utilized in the delivery of health information and DEC drug for the elimination of LF; 2) the involvement of AWWs in MDA program could achieve higher coverage and consumption in the urban areas; 3) the AWWs should be trained to deliver the health information and DEC drugs; and 4) the IEC campaign targeting less compliant groups could enhance the coverage and compliance.
